correspondences.notes: File has no extension and no JSON sidecar; technique assumed light-sheet from the App.

brainlife.desc: Light-sheet microscopy TIFF stack, created for the APEX hackathon; input to TIFF-to-Zarr v3 deskewing.
brainlife.name: tif

original.desc: Microscopy data for the APEX hackathon

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Deskewing light-sheet TIFF into Zarr v3.

**Not for:** General microscopy; prefer neuro/tiff-volume or neuro/ome-zarr.

**BIDS:** micr/SPIM (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/tif.json

files.desc: BIDS microscopy JSON sidecar (e.g. PixelSize, PixelSizeUnits).

identifying_risks: Specimen IDs in TIFF tags may link to a donor.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 2: human status depends on the specimen; participant-level tissue images carry no direct identifiers (Tier 2), non-human data is Tier 1.
sharing_cautions: Confirm species and donor consent terms before sharing human tissue images.
tier_conditions: Tier 1 when the specimen is non-human (e.g. mouse) or synthetic.
Tier 2 for human tissue linked to a donor or specimen code.

intended_use: Deskewing light-sheet TIFF into Zarr v3.
not_suitable_for: General microscopy; prefer neuro/tiff-volume or neuro/ome-zarr.
